test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Prime Minister of Bangladesh, Sheikh Hasina was conferred with which of the following prestigious awards on 20 September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SDG Progress Award.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh's c**onsistent progress toward reaching the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) **has earned** Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina** the SDG Progress Award from the **UN-sponsored SDSN.**
 
• In order to advance the Sustainable Development Goals, the** United Nations** established the** United Nations Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)** in **2012.**
 
• **President:** Professor Jeffrey Sachs** **
 
• **Headquarters:** New York, United States 
 
• **Founded: **August 2012**​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Swadhinata Puraskar:**

 
 
• The **highest state honor** bestowed by the **Bangladeshi government **is known as the **Independence Day Award,** or Independence Award, **Swadhinata Padak, or Swadhinata Puroskar.​**
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi Prize:**
 
 
• ​The distinguished prize given each year by the** Indira Gandhi Memorial Trust** is known as the** Indira Gandhi Prize,** or the** Indira Gandhi Peace Prize** or the** Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development.**
 
• In order to ensure that scientific advancements are exploited for the** greater welfare of humanity **and to broaden the **definition of freedom,** it is granted to people or organizations in appreciation of their innovative work in advancing** international peace, development, and a new international economic system.**
 
• The honor includes a **citation and a cash reward of 2.5 million Indian rupees.**
